page.overview:
What is The Frayed Ends of Sanity?

The Frayed Ends of Sanity is the 7th track off of Metallica's 1988 album ...And Justice for All.

The song is about an individual that is becoming increasingly paranoid and scared about a supposed conspiracy against him, and therefore on the brink of losing his mind.

The songs intro includes a sound sample of the Winkie chant from the movie The Wizard of Oz. At 7:44 it is the 3rd longest track on ...And Justice for All. "The Frayed Ends of Sanity" is renowned to be a fan favorite and in the past many petitions were raised among Metallica fans to get the song played live.

Never hunger, never prosper I have fallen prey to failure Struggle within, triggered again Now the candle burns on both ends
